Subject: Executive sponsor — compact evening briefing & buffer proposal

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As we discussed, since your VP of Product and CIO have very tight calendars next week, I wanted to propose a compact evening briefing that keeps the exec window to ~20 minutes but provides an extra 10-minute buffer for Q&A or a brief wrap.

Quick proposal (all times PDT):
- 30-minute slot total (5:30–6:00pm)
  - 5:30–5:10pm: demo highlights (10m) + brief architecture callouts (10m)
  - 5:40–5:50pm: targeted Q&A with CIO/VP (10m)
  - 5:50–6:00pm: wrap / next steps (10m buffer)

I attached an updated mutual action plan and a one-sheet that calls out the specific areas the CIO has asked to see. If the CIO prefers a morning slot, we can also compress to a 25-minute block but wanted to float the evening guardrail first so we can keep the hands-on engineering run later in the day without blocking the execs.

If that structure works, can you confirm if the VP will join for the first 15 minutes and the CIO for the Q&A? Also please flag any conflicts for Tue/Wed next week (May 9–10).

Thanks —
Irene

--

Irene —

Appreciate the clear options. The VP (Clara) can make an evening slot that day but only until 5:45pm; the CIO (Ahmed) is only available after 5:35pm for a hard 20-minute window. To keep both present for an overlap, can we move the slot slightly earlier to 5:20–5:50pm PDT? That gives the VP 5:20–5:35 and the CIO 5:35–5:50 (15/15 overlap).

One ask: Ahmed wants a 2-slide callout on data residency and audit trails up front. Can you add that to the running order? Also, Sarah (security lead) will join if Ahmed requests deeper details — I copied her here.

Tom
